```{r}
dt <- read.table('advert_w_colnames.dat', header = TRUE)
dt$groupf <- as.factor(dt$group)

w <- model.matrix(response ~ groupf-1, data = dt)

x <- model.matrix(response ~ groupf, data = dt)

ai <- rbind(
    cbind(1,0,0,0,0,0), 
    cbind(1,1,0,0,0,0), 
    cbind(1,0,1,0,0,0), 
    cbind(1,0,0,1,0,0),
    cbind(1,0,0,0,1,0),
    cbind(1,0,0,0,0,1))
ai
a <- solve(ai)

w%*%ai

solve(t(w)%*%w)%*%t(w)%*%dt$response
solve(t(x)%*%x)%*%t(x)%*%dt$response
```
